And that he would shew<WH05046><WTH8686> thee the secrets<WH08587> of wisdom<WH02451>, that <FI>they are<Fi> double<WH03718> to that which is<WH08454>! Know<WH03045><WTH8798> therefore that God<WH0433> exacteth<WH05382><WTH8686> of thee <FI>less<Fi>  than thine iniquity<WH05771> <FI>deserveth<Fi> .<CM>
Canst thou by searching<WH02714> find out<WH04672><WTH8799> God<WH0433>? canst thou find<WH04672><WTH8799> out the Almighty<WH07706> unto perfection<WH08503>?

<FI> It is<Fi> as high<WH01363> as heaven<WH08064>; what canst thou do<WH06466><WTH8799>? deeper<WH06013> than hell<WH07585>; what canst thou know<WH03045><WTH8799>? <RF>as high...: Heb. the heights of heaven<Rf>
The measure<WH04055> thereof <FI>is<Fi> longer<WH0752> than the earth<WH0776>, and broader<WH07342> than the sea<WH03220>.

If he cut off<WH02498><WTH8799>, and shut up<WH05462><WTH8686>, or gather together<WH06950><WTH8686>, then who can hinder<WH07725><WTH8686> him? <RF>cut...: or, make a change<Rf> <RF>hinder...: Heb. turn him away?<Rf>
For he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> vain<WH07723> men<WH04962>: he seeth<WH07200><WTH8799> wickedness<WH0205> also; will he not then consider<WH0995><WTH8709> <FI>it<Fi> ?
For vain<WH05014><WTH8803> man<WH0376> would be wise<WH03823><WTH8735>, though man<WH0120> be born<WH03205><WTH8735> <FI>like<Fi> a wild ass's<WH06501> colt<WH05895>. <RF>vain: Heb. empty<Rf><CM>
If thou prepare<WH03559><WTH8689> thine heart<WH03820>, and stretch<WH06566><WTH8804> out thine hands<WH03709> toward him;

And <FI>thine<Fi> age<WH02465> shall be clearer<WH06965><WTH8799> than the noonday<WH06672>; thou shalt shine forth<WH05774><WTH8799>, thou shalt be as the morning<WH01242>. <RF>be clearer...: Heb. arise above<Rf>

And thou shalt be secure<WH0982><WTH8804>, because there is<WH03426> hope<WH08615>; yea, thou shalt dig<WH02658><WTH8804> <FI>about thee, and<Fi> thou shalt take thy rest<WH07901><WTH8799> in safety<WH0983>.

Also thou shalt lie down<WH07257><WTH8804>, and none shall make <FI>thee<Fi> afraid<WH02729><WTH8688>; yea, many<WH07227> shall make suit<WH02470><WTH8765> unto thee<WH06440>. <RF>make suit...: Heb. intreat thy face<Rf>

But the eyes<WH05869> of the wicked<WH07563> shall fail<WH03615><WTH8799>, and they shall not escape<WH06><WTH8804><WH04498>, and their hope<WH08615> <FI>shall be as<Fi> the giving up<WH04646> of the ghost<WH05315>. <RF>they shall...: Heb. flight shall perish from them<Rf> <RF>the giving...: or, a puff of breath<Rf><CM>
